thread:
Maria (PM): Draft PRD for edge-case handling in generation APIs. Need a concise list of acceptance criteria + prioritized edge cases for streaming/truncation/retries. @sahil @jun please weigh in.

Sahil (Eng): Quick note: restarted streams can leak KV-cache mismatch if partial tokens consumed; we need idempotency/resume token. Also consider truncated final token vs completed stop token.

Jun (ML): quantization + tokenization differences between model variants -> off-by-one in token count and end-of-sequence signals. Add test harness.

Maya (DevEx): SDK proposal: include resume_token in stream metadata and an event type 'incomplete_end' when truncated. Example:
```
{ "event": "chunk", "text": "...", "resume_token": "rt_abc123" }
{ "event": "incomplete_end", "reason": "token_limit" }
```

Alex (Oncall): +1. Also, default retries should be 1 for streaming to avoid duplicate outputs to downstream consumers. Backoff: jittered exponential.

Eva (CS): Several enterprise customers asked for 'partial transcripts' billing: want per-chunk billing and clear truncation flag.

Maggie (Product): From prioritization perspective: must-have for Dedicated & Private customers; nice-to-have for Hosted initial launch. Can we surface canary metrics?

Sahil (Eng): Canary metrics: % of streams ending with 'incomplete_end', median time to resume with token, duplicate-output rate post-retry. Add SLOs: <0.5% incomplete_end for non-rate-limited requests.

Jun (ML): Edge-case list I'm adding to PRD draft:
```
- truncated_mid_token: stream hits token_limit mid-token -> partial utf8
- kv_mismatch_on_resume: resumed session uses different model version
- duplicate_chunks_on_retry: client receives overlapping chunks
- eos_marker_missing: model doesn't emit EOS token
- partial_function_call: tool-calling stream emits half-structured JSON
```

Maya (DevEx): Acceptance criteria suggestion:
```
1) SDK supports resume_token with deterministic resume semantics
2) Server emits explicit 'incomplete_end' with reason
3) Retry behavior documented and default: 1 retry for streaming
4) E2E tests cover resume + duplicate suppression
5) Billing flag per chunk for partial outputs
```

Maria (PM): Great. Owner assignments?

Sahil (Eng): I'll own server changes + metrics.

Maya (DevEx): I'll own SDK changes + examples.

Jun (ML): I'll own test harness + model-version guardrails.

Maggie (Product): I'll draft launch criteria and customer comms.

deploy-bot: Preview PR created: https://git.redwood/p/r/1234

Maria (PM): Thanks — I'll update the PRD with this and ping for RFC review. Meeting to prioritize on Monday 10am.

Alex (Oncall): Bringing up retention: keep resume tokens for 48h by default, configurable.

Eva (CS): Noted — we'll prep a customer FAQ about how truncation affects billing.

Maggie (Product): One more tradeoff: resume_token may be PII-sensitive if prompts included -> must hash.

Sahil (Eng): Agree. Server will hash resume payload client-side with per-tenant salt.

Maria (PM): Ok locking those decisions. Thanks all :thumbsup:
